purpose: Teach: アングル/ブラザー/キャリー/ストリング/ブックス/アンバランス/ワンポイント/ダート

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「写真のアングルで印象が変わる」って教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was teaching me how the angle of a photograph can completely change the impression it gives.
lines.style: Warm, sharing a small observation about her son's father. Gentle pride in the detail she's noticed. Even pace, conversational. A soft smile lives in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとブラザーのミシンで縫い物したよ
lines.en: Mom, I sewed something with Dad and big brother on the sewing machine!
lines.style: Bright, eager to report. Quick tempo on the main action. Small pride swelling behind the words. Expects delight in return.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがキャリー・フィッシャーの伝記本を読んでらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is reading Carrie Fisher's biography these days.
lines.style: Thoughtful, noticing something interesting about her husband. Soft wonder underneath — registering his tastes. Slight trailing-off, like the thought is still forming.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとピアノのストリング、つまり弦の張力勉強したよ
lines.en: Mom, I learned about piano strings with Dad — the tension and everything!
lines.style: Eager to share new knowledge. Slight breathlessness on the technical detail. Proud of understanding something 'grown-up'. Warm directness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとブックス、つまり大型書店巡りに行かれるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to bookstores with me — you know, the big ones.
lines.style: Gentle amusement in the parenthetical clarification. Tender towards the small ritual they're building. Even, almost dreamy pace. The comfort of routine.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「アンバランスな食事はダメ」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me that eating in a lopsided way isn't good for you.
lines.style: Earnest and sincere. The tone of a child who has absorbed something 'important' from a trusted adult. No rush. Careful, as if repeating something worth preserving.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがワンポイントの和柄ネクタイをお選びだったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad picked out a subtle Japanese-patterned tie with a single accent detail.
lines.style: Delighted noticing — the small aesthetic choice of a man she knows well. Warmth and amusement at the specificity. Clear, unhurried. Pride in his taste.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと競馬のダートレース観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a dirt-track horse race with Dad!
lines.style: Bright and immediate. Quick, staccato opening on the memory. Energy peaks on 'race' and settles into contentment. The voice of a child who just lived something fun and is still riding that joy.
